query:
SELECT p.id as pkg_id, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.isActive, p.startDate, p.endDate,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendances a WHERE a.packageId = p.id AND a.attendanceType = 'normal') as nb_attendances,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.durationMinutes),0) FROM attendances a WHERE a.packageId = p.id AND a.attendanceType = 'normal') as sum_minutes
FROM packages p WHERE p.residentId = 60001 ORDER BY p.startDate;
